$comment: Screenshots allowed to stay taller than MAX_HEIGHT in e2e/screenshotSize.ts, which is the design 12.3 size gate. Same bargain as security/audit-exceptions.json: every entry names a reason, an owner and an expiry, the gate fails once an expiry passes, and it fails again once a listed shot comes in comfortably under the limit -- so an entry cannot outlive the fix it was waiting for, and nothing lives here by being forgotten. A shot that is simply too tall belongs in the spec that takes it, not here.

exceptions.reason: A deliberate whole-page phone shot of the patient summary (e2e/mobile.spec.ts asks for WHOLE_PAGE): the page is long by design, not by data, and the point of the shot is the whole of it. T57 (#87) landed the per-project default and left this one as the exception it is.

Desktop shots of the provider dashboard, where T57 (#87) shoots the whole document on purpose: a desktop row is one line of a table, so the page is worth having whole, but the list grows a row per visit every other spec books and these land between 4,000 and 6,200 pixels by the time they are taken. The phone equivalents are now one screenful each and no longer need excusing.
